messages:
elaine: Quick check — batch preview > export keyboard flow. Did a short walkthrough and flagged a few a11y/copy nits: export CTA not reachable by keyboard from row actions, no SR announce when export starts, and confirmation copy doesn't mention rerank scores. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/figma/abc.png
rohit: Good catches. Suggest adding an aria-live="polite" status region that updates on start/finish. Also ensure the Export CTA gets a tabindex and visible focus ring (currently hidden by custom focus styles).
sam: Copy suggestions: modal title -> 'Export vectors', subcopy -> 'Includes rerank scores and embeddings for selected rows.' Confirm btn -> 'Export 12 rows' (make count dynamic). CSV header proposal:
```csv
id,text,embedding_vector,rerank_score
```
elaine: UX nit on tab order: when tabbing from a selected row checkbox it should go to the row menu, then toolbar, then export. Right now toolbar is skipped and focus lands unexpectedly. We should trap focus in the modal on open.
design-bot: Accessibility scan result: Export CTA contrast ratio 3.8:1 on current blue (#1e88e5) vs white. Target >=4.5:1. Suggested darker blue #005bb5 or increase font weight/uppercase.
rohit: Implementation plan: 1) add hidden aria-live region with sr-only text updates: 'Export started for {N} items.' and 'Export complete — download ready'. 2) change Export button aria-label to 'Open export modal (includes rerank scores)'. 3) add keyboard shortcut (when preview has focus) 'e' to open export, ensure configurable.
sam: Regarding keyboard shortcut — prefer Shift+E for export all to avoid accidental opens. Also add a visible tooltip on hover with shortcut.
elaine: Accessibility acceptance criteria (for the ticket):
- Export modal traps focus and restores focus to invoking element on close
- aria-live announces start/completion with clear, concise copy
- Export CTA color/contrast >= 4.5:1
- Confirmation copy explicitly states 'includes rerank scores'
- Keyboard shortcut added with discoverable tooltip and no conflicts
I'll draft the PR text and update Figma frames. Assigning @sam to update CSV header + copy, @rohit to prototype aria-live + keyboard handling.
sam: on it :thumbsup:
rohit: will prototype and post a tiny demo in eng-runtime channel when done.
elaine: thanks — i'll open the design PR and link back here when ready.
